name: cache-monitor
description: Shows how long Claude's chat memory (prompt cache) stays active and what your next message costs, with a plain-language tip

rebuildLimitUsd.title: Rebuild limit ($)
rebuildLimitUsd.description: Above this cost of rebuilding the chat beyond what a new chat would cost anyway, the bar turns red and suggests a handoff.

warnMinutes.title: Warning time (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: How early the bar turns yellow before the chat memory expires (1-hour memory only; the 5-minute memory never turns yellow).

longChatTokens.title: Long chat size (tokens)
longChatTokens.description: Chat size at which the bar suggests starting a new chat after the current task.

costStyle.title: Show cost as
costStyle.description: dollars shows approximate $ amounts; times shows how many times more than a normal message.

memoryMinutes.title: Memory time
memoryMinutes.description: auto = learned from each reply (1 hour on a subscription within its plan; 5 minutes on usage credits, an API key, a cloud provider or a TTL setting). 5 or 60 forces it.

freshChatTokens.title: Fresh chat size (tokens)
freshChatTokens.description: What a new chat's first prompt sends (system prompt, tools, CLAUDE.md, memory). 0 = measured from your own chats (35000 until 5 are measured). Used for the handoff saving and the red light.

handoffModel.title: Handoff model
handoffModel.description: Model /cache-monitor-handoff uses to write the summary (haiku is the cheapest). Pick "custom" to use the id you type in "Custom handoff model". Also settable with /cache-monitor-model.

handoffModelCustom.title: Custom handoff model
handoffModelCustom.description: Used only when Handoff model is "custom": any alias or full model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5-20260401.
